name: html-guide-kit
description: Explicitly create a teaching guide in chat, or build a sourced Chinese learning website through Sites with local materials and checks.

interface.shortDescription: Create teaching guides and learning websites through Sites
interface.longDescription: Use guide for new copyable teaching-guide text in chat within its Read-only contract. Use site for the explicit six-step workflow from material and understanding goals to local Markdown, a learning website, checks and actual Sites publication. Reuse confirmed decisions and wait for necessary answers. Preserve sources, conditions and unknowns; report actual verification and learning effects separately.
defaultPrompt: Use $html-guide-kit:guide for a new teaching guide; offer reader, task and question options, then wait for my confirmation.
Use $html-guide-kit:site to build a Chinese learning website through Sites from this material, with sources and checks.
